log_level.description: Verbosity of ipp-usb logging. Use 'debug' for detailed diagnostics, 'info' for normal operation.

ipp_usb_socket.description: Unix domain socket path used for IPC with clients (e.g., CUPS).

lock_file.description: Lock file path to ensure only one instance manages USB devices.

max_open_handles.description: Maximum number of USB device handles to keep open concurrently. Increase if you use many simultaneous devices.

auto_start.description: If enabled, the ipp-usb service is started automatically on system boot via systemd.

blacklisted_devices.description: List of USB vendor:product IDs (e.g., '045e:07c6') to explicitly ignore, even if not blacklisted by ipp-usb internally.

items.description: USB vendor:product ID in the format '045e:07c6' (hex, no '0x').

whitelisted_devices.description: If non-empty, only devices in this list will be handled (allowlist). Empty list = handle all except blacklisted devices.

items.description: USB vendor:product ID in the format '045e:07c6' (hex, no '0x').

retry_delay_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds between retry attempts when attaching a USB device.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries when attempting to attach a USB device before giving up.

libusb_debug.description: Debug level for libusb (0–4). 0 = no logging, 4 = full verbose logging. Use only for troubleshooting.

log_target.description: Where to send logs: 'syslog' (recommended), 'stderr' (for foreground debugging), or 'none' (disable logging).
